heroHeading:
Building Democratic Leadership
Rooted in Putnam County
heroBody: PCYD is organizing a new generation of local leaders, volunteers, and precinct-level party members right here in Putnam County, Florida.
whatWeDoIntro: PCYD focuses on five core areas to strengthen Democratic organizing at the county level.

whatWeDoCards.title: Recruit and Retain Members
whatWeDoCards.body: Build a structured local organization with clear responsibilities, regular meetings, and meaningful follow-up for young Democrats and left-leaning residents.

whatWeDoCards.title: Develop Leaders
whatWeDoCards.body: Prepare members for precinct seats, committee work, campaign activity, voter registration, and future DEC service.

whatWeDoCards.title: Engage Voters
whatWeDoCards.body: Support lawful voter registration and education efforts ahead of the 2026 primary and general elections.

whatWeDoCards.title: Host Public Events
whatWeDoCards.body: Organize gatherings, educational events, and community activities that increase local Democratic visibility and participation.

whatWeDoCards.title: Strengthen Party Infrastructure
whatWeDoCards.body: Build the local Democratic bench by preparing members for county party operations, especially precinct-level service.

ctaBody: Whether you want to run for a precinct seat, help with voter outreach, or just show up and learn, there is a place for you here.
